newReleaseLeaderFault.scope: Includes SSH, signal dispatch, verifier JVM/bootstrap and canonical/retry/conflict checks; first-new-write latency was not measured.

limitations: Single 900-command closed-loop trial per measurement, one request in flight; sustainable capacity unmeasured.
Control leader 2 and patched leader 0 differ. Timing, retained-state size and shared-host scheduling also differ; throughput/median changes cannot be attributed solely to this patch.
Local regression reproduces the ADMIN_ACTION drop directly. Historical cloud offer return codes were not recorded, so individual old tails have no direct server-side trace.
Client accepted resends do not count server response-offer retries. Finite zero observed resends do not establish universal zero loss or latency bounds.

The reference uses the same MatchingEngine implementation. Physical anti-affinity, an independent load host, PostgreSQL HA, Pod-stop/power-loss durability and high connection-count fanout remain unverified.
